_comment: Faith system data for Episode 11: Faith. Destiny discovers a habitable planet. The crew debates whether to settle permanently or continue the mission. Build camp, explore, survive, and face the moral choice: stay on the planet or continue aboard Destiny.

scenario.title: Faith
scenario.description: Destiny drops out of FTL near a habitable planet — the first truly Earth-like world the crew has found. Some want to settle, to end the endless journey. Others believe the ship's mission must continue. Build a settlement, explore the planet, and decide the fate of the crew.

debate.title: The Debate
debate.description: The crew argues in the gate room. Rush insists the mission must continue. Young wants a vote. Chloe sees a future. Scott wants safety. Eli fears both choices.

landing.title: Shuttle Landing
landing.description: A shuttle descends to the planet surface. The crew must land safely on the plateau.

settlement.title: Building the Camp
settlement.description: The crew begins building a permanent settlement. Structures rise from the soil. Life takes root.

exploration.title: Exploring the Planet
exploration.description: The planet stretches in every direction. The crew explores, gathers resources, and maps the world.

survival.title: Long-Term Survival
survival.description: Days become weeks. The settlement faces challenges — storms, food scarcity, illness. The crew adapts or fractures.

moral_choice.title: Stay or Continue
moral_choice.description: The planet offers safety but the mission calls. The crew must choose: settle permanently or return to Destiny.

resolved.title: Resolution
resolved.description: The decision is made. The crew lives with the consequences.

shelter.label: Shelters
shelter.description: Basic shelters protect the crew from the elements. Made from local materials and shuttle cargo.

water_well.label: Water Well
water_well.description: A well taps into the planet's water table. Clean water flows for the first time in weeks.

farm_plot.label: Farm Plots
farm_plot.description: Seeds from hydroponics are planted in the planet's soil. The first crops will take time.

perimeter_fence.label: Perimeter Fence
perimeter_fence.description: A fence surrounds the camp. It keeps out wildlife and provides a sense of security.

med_station.label: Medical Station
med_station.description: A small medical station is set up using supplies from the shuttle. TJ can treat injuries on-site.

power_array.label: Solar Power Array
power_array.description: Solar panels from the shuttle are deployed. The camp has electricity for the first time.

communication_relay.label: Communication Relay
communication_relay.description: A relay is built to maintain contact with Destiny in orbit. Eli riggs the shuttle's comm system.

northern_ridge.label: Northern Ridge
northern_ridge.description: A ridge overlooks the valley. The view reveals the planet's vast wilderness.

eastern_forest.label: Eastern Forest
eastern_forest.description: A dense forest stretches east. Trees unlike any on Earth tower above.

southern_river.label: Southern River
southern_river.description: A river flows south. The water is clear and teeming with life.

western_caves.label: Western Caves
western_caves.description: Caves dot the western hills. They may hold resources — or dangers.

central_valley.label: Central Valley
central_valley.description: The valley between the camp and the ridge. Fertile soil stretches for kilometers.

storm.label: Great Storm
storm.description: A massive storm sweeps across the valley. Shelters strain under the wind. Crops are damaged.

illness.label: Fever Outbreak
illness.description: A fever spreads through the camp. TJ works around the clock. The medical station is critical.

food_shortage.label: Food Shortage
food_shortage.description: The crops failed to yield in time. Rations run low. The crew must forage or face starvation.

wildlife_attack.label: Wildlife Attack
wildlife_attack.description: Large creatures approach the camp at night. The perimeter fence is put to the test.

water_contamination.label: Water Contamination
water_contamination.description: The well water turns cloudy. Something in the soil is leaching into the supply.

rush_mission.speaker: Rush
rush_mission.text: This planet is a distraction. Destiny's mission is older than human civilization. We cannot abandon it for comfort.

young_safety.speaker: Young
young_safety.text: I've lost count of how many people have died on this ship. If this planet can keep them alive, I have to consider it.

chloe_future.speaker: Chloe
chloe_future.text: For the first time since we left Earth, I can imagine a future. A home. Children who grow up under an open sky.

scott_duty.speaker: Scott
scott_duty.text: I took an oath. But that oath was to protect these people. Maybe this is how I protect them.

eli_fear.speaker: Eli
eli_fear.text: I'm afraid of both choices. Stay here and we might die slowly. Keep going and we might die fast. At least here we have a chance.

greer_practical.speaker: Greer
greer_practical.text: I've fought in deserts and jungles. This place is peaceful. But peaceful doesn't mean safe. We don't know what's out there.

tj_healing.speaker: TJ
tj_healing.text: In the infirmary, I see what this ship does to people. The stress, the injuries, the hopelessness. This planet could heal them.

camille_home.speaker: Camille
camille_home.text: Home isn't a place. It's the people you're with. But a real home — with walls and a garden — that's something worth fighting for.

stay.label: Settle on the Planet
stay.description: Abandon Destiny and make the planet your permanent home. The crew will build a new life under an open sky. The ship's mission ends here.
stay.narrative: The crew votes to stay. Shelters become homes. The camp becomes a village. Destiny orbits silently above, its mission unfinished. Rush works alone in the shuttle, refusing to accept the decision. But the rest of the crew — for the first time — looks forward to tomorrow.

continue.label: Continue the Mission
continue.description: Return to Destiny and continue the mission. The planet was a temporary refuge, not a permanent home. The crew reboards the ship and dials the next gate.
continue.narrative: The crew votes to continue. The camp is dismantled. The shuttle lifts off, and the planet recedes below. Some crew members stare out the viewport in silence. Rush nods, satisfied. The mission goes on — but something was left behind on that world. Something the crew will not forget.

split.label: Let the Crew Choose
split.description: Allow anyone who wishes to stay behind. The rest continue on Destiny. The crew fractures — but each person chooses their own fate.
split.narrative: Young offers the choice. Several crew members stay — Chloe, TJ, Camille among them. The rest board the shuttle. As Destiny's gate dials, those who remain watch from the surface. The crew is divided, but each person chose their path. Rush calls it a waste. Young calls it freedom.
